Photo 1 shows the same console with a black game controller (Xbox One controller) placed on top. The controller has the Xbox logo and colored face buttons (X, Y, A, B).
The console appears to be in used condition with visible wear and smudges on the surface.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims the console has 6 games including FC, but no games are shown or listed.
